title: B面の夜
caption: Mellow instrumental hip hop made from Japanese city pop. A slow, dusty boom-bap drum loop with a lazy swing, warm round bass, dreamy Rhodes electric piano playing lush major seventh chords, a looped clean guitar phrase with chorus effect, soft string pads, a wistful soprano saxophone melody, gentle vinyl crackle and occasional record scratches. Relaxed, nostalgic, cruising slowly through the sleeping city. Instrumental, no vocals.
